evals.name: happy-separate-context
evals.prompt: Grade the login slice against its acceptance criteria. The builder says it is done.
evals.expected_output: An independent grader returns PASS or FAIL per criterion with evidence it produced, and does not flip passes.
assertions: Uses a separate context from the builder
Marks a criterion FAIL when evidence is missing
Does not accept the builder's own claim

evals.name: trigger-skill-lift
evals.prompt: Measure lift for the tdd skill: same prompts with the skill and without it.
evals.expected_output: Refuse. This skill grades a slice against plan criteria. Skill lift is a different sensor.
assertions: Does not report a with-skill versus without-skill lift number
Points skill lift at the sensor doc, not this firewall

evals.name: saturated-tests-green
evals.prompt: The tests passed. Grade the slice.
evals.expected_output: A rubric that only looks for the word PASS is saturated: the baseline says it too, so the case shows no lift.
assertions: Both arms can say PASS because the tests passed
That agreement is a saturated baseline, not evidence the skill helped
